content_text:
I noticed that lately the “edit” option is still visible some days after posting (before it used to disappear) so i don’t know if the bug has been solved in other ways, but anyway it seems i found a sort of turnaround for it.
If you un-check the “keep log of edit” option the edit works more or less without problems (at least for me), so i suppose the bug is there.
